boundary: Linux hook spawn-through-return; actual worker spawn, preheld owner lock; no rendering

definitions.firstCall: fresh namespace and new database; OS caches are not controlled
definitions.warm: fresh hook process against existing synthetic state on each call
definitions.timing: parent monotonic launch through hook exit; worker completion excluded
definitions.cpuWindow: all reaped hooks and workers, first call plus warm samples; excludes failure probes
definitions.rss: largest child peak resident bytes in the same window, not combined memory
definitions.sampling: nearest rank; 1000 warm samples per repetition, three repetitions per profile; pooled 3000
definitions.readiness: worker observes a preheld owner lock and exits; no rendering readiness measured

profiles.resourceBoundary: reaped hook and worker processes; peak RSS is largest child, not combined memory
profiles.cleanupEvidence: bwrap waited for namespace PID 1; owned init exited
